title: Riverside Clock Tower Town
description: A vibrant cartoon cityscape at sunset featuring a tall ornate clock tower, a canal running through the center with boats, and colorful European-style buildings lining cobblestone streets. A steam train crosses a stone viaduct on the left while a fountain plaza and market stalls occupy the town square.
prompt: Whimsical cartoon cityscape at sunset with a prominent ornate clock tower beside a central canal filled with sailboats. Colorful multi-story buildings with shops and market stalls line the cobblestone streets. A blue steam train travels across a high stone viaduct on the left. Fountain in the town square, warm orange and purple sky with soft clouds, vibrant and playful atmosphere.
